# README Asset Sources

[简体中文](SOURCES.md) | [English](SOURCES.en.md)

## Interface and Logo

The OpenPictureStudio logo comes from `resources/assets/logo.png` in this repository.

`windows-smartscreen.zh-CN.png` is an actual Windows SmartScreen screenshot supplied by the project maintainer, showing the 0.16.0 installer. Rights to the Windows interface, names, and marks belong to Microsoft. The screenshot accompanies installation instructions.

## Product Screenshots

| File | Content | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace.png` | OpenPictureStudio editing workspace in English | Supplied by the project maintainer |
| `viewer.png` | OpenPictureStudio View mode in English | Supplied by the project maintainer |
| `beauty-default.png` | Initial Beauty settings at 84% zoom in English | Supplied by the project maintainer |
| `beauty-adjusted.png` | Beauty adjustments at 131% zoom in English | Supplied by the project maintainer |

The example photo in the viewing and editing screenshots is named `Mount Fuji.png`; the portrait retouching screenshots use `Photo.png`. All screenshots retain their original framing and dimensions.

## Diagram and Icons

The README's Mermaid workflow diagram was authored by the OpenPictureStudio project. See [SOURCE.txt](../../../resources/icons/ui/SOURCE.txt) and [LICENSE.txt](../../../resources/icons/ui/LICENSE.txt) for the source and MIT license of the Tabler Icons used in the interface.
